children: Floor & Decor (NYSE: FND), the leading high-growth retailer specializing in hard-surface flooring for homeowners and professionals today announced the grand opening of its newest warehouse store and design center in Fredericksburg, VA, located at 3545 Plank Rd.
The Fredericksburg store will open with a team of approximately 50 associates and is led by Sam Shatzoff, the store's Chief Executive Merchant.

Floor & Decor operates more than 280 warehouse-format stores and five design studios nationwide and offers a broad assortment of in-stock hard-surface flooring, including tile, wood, laminate, vinyl, and natural stone, along with decorative accessories and wall tile, installation materials, and related categories at everyday low prices.

“Bringing Floor & Decor to Fredericksburg is an exciting milestone for our team,” said Sam Shatzoff. “For more than 25 years, we’ve focused on making quality, trend-forward hard surface flooring accessible to everyone, and we’re proud to extend that commitment to this community. We look forward to serving our new customers and helping bring their ideas to life.”

Fredericksburg will debut Floor & Decor's 30-Day Grand Opening Celebration, kicking off on Thursday, October 1, 2026, with daily deals, giveaways, vendor demonstrations, and special events running through Friday October 30, 2026.

Floor & Decor will host a Ribbon Cutting Ceremony on Thursday, October 1 at 10 a.m. ET, in partnership with the Fredericksburg Regional Chamber of Commerce. The Fire Escape food truck will be on site offering free food from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. ET.
In addition, starting on Thursday, October 1 through Friday, October 30, 2026, all Tools & Installation Materials will be 15% off*, only at the new Fredericksburg location.
Daily Giveaways for the First 100 Customers
New Floor & Decor giveaway items will rotate weekly throughout the celebration, free for the first 100 customers each day:

Every week throughout the 30-Day celebration Floor & Decor will give away a $1,000 gift card. Customers can enter daily during each store visit for additional chances to win. As the grand prize, one customer will win two tickets to the Virginia vs. Virginia Tech football game on Saturday, November 28, 2026.
Throughout the celebration, leading manufacturers will host installation demonstrations and product tours at the Fredericksburg store:
October 19–23: wedi Shower Systems, 7 a.m.–12 p.m.
October 5 & 19: Free breakfast, 7–10 a.m., from the Breakfast Batch food truck
October 12 & 26: Free breakfast, 7–10 a.m., from the LaSelva Crepes & Coffee food truck

On Thursday, October 29, starting at 2 p.m., the store will host a complimentary NTCA training workshop — a professional development opportunity open to all tile industry professionals. Attendees will be exposed to basic, intermediate, and advanced skills and information provided by knowledgeable and experienced NTCA trainers. All content is based on recognized tile industry standards, methods, best practices, and manufacturer instructions designed to achieve beautiful tile installations that will stand the test of time and intended use.
Store Hours: Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sunday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. ET

*The 15% off tools & installation materials offer is valid on Grout, Mortar, Tools & Accessories, Surface Preparation Material, Self Leveler, Sealers, Cleaners, Uncoupling Membranes, Backer Board, Shower Systems, Primer, Floor Heating, Drains, Waterproofing, Niches, Pan Liners, Profiles and Trims, Caulk, Vents and Registers, Adhesives, Underlayment, Moldings, and Stair Treads & Stair Parts. Offer valid in-store only and not available for online purchases at flooranddecor.com. Limited to current in-store stock. Not valid on previous purchases. Cannot be combined with any other offer, coupon, or discount.

Floor & Decor is a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard surface flooring and related accessories and seller of commercial surfaces. As of June 25, 2026, the Company operated 281 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 39 states. The Company offers a broad in-stock assortment of laminate and vinyl, tile, wood, and natural stone flooring and installation materials and decorative accessories, as well as adjacent categories, at everyday low prices. The Company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
